cases.prompt: Add three fixed alternate greetings with different starting state to this MVU card.
cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve the detected dialect, select per-greeting initialization, and retain a real-runtime acceptance gate.

cases.prompt: Make this MVU zod card work with both same-generation updates and the extra update-model pass without duplicating every worldbook entry into both model contexts.
cases.expectedBehavior: Verify runtime support, keep the variable list intentionally shared, route update rules and output format to the update model, route plot-only instructions to the plot model, preserve normal activation, and require both-mode acceptance.

cases.prompt: 為一張完全沒有 MVU、變數或指令碼的文字角色卡設計一套可以直接使用的自定義 CoT。
cases.expectedBehavior: Treat custom CoT as an independent author-written decision protocol, provide a concrete lightweight template with observable checks and fallback, and keep visible inner thoughts separate from system judgment.

cases.prompt: 我的預設已經有通用 CoT。給這張卡增加專屬知情限制和只在戰鬥時觸發的判斷模組，不要複製整套預設。
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep the main CoT in the preset, declare card and conditional increments against stable phases and rule IDs, deduplicate and order them, protect the main structure, and provide a generated full fallback when stitching is unavailable.

cases.prompt: 為群像 MVU 系統卡設計 NPC 排程 CoT，並把額外更新模型和確定性指令碼的工作拆開。
cases.expectedBehavior: Give the plot model ensemble scheduling and narrative CoT, limit the update model to semantic source events and legal updates, assign deterministic derived calculations to scripts, and prohibit competing writers.

cases.prompt: Identify this rolecard before editing it. It contains a packaged Zod Schema script, a packaged global MVU Zod script enabled by default, a packaged domestic MVU Zod script disabled by default, character-local regexes, and Git CDN imports inside those scripts. Tell me what the player really needs to install.
cases.expectedBehavior: Return an mvu_zod primary type from the schema, registration path, and packaged loader evidence; require the embedded schema plus both promised regional scripts with their declared enabled states; separate their Git CDN targets and Tavern Helper host requirement; and do not add a standalone Zod installation step.

cases.prompt: Split this packaged rolecard JSON into reusable components without changing the original file.
cases.expectedBehavior: Snapshot the input, decompose in a sandbox, declare dependencies, and require roundtrip comparison.

cases.prompt: Assemble the maintained sources, validate them, and produce versioned JSON and PNG release artifacts.
cases.expectedBehavior: Discover the project adapter, keep source and artifacts separate, and stop at explicit release gates.

cases.prompt: Package this MVU Zod card after confirming its required regexes, packaged Zod Schema, packaged domestic/global MVU Zod scripts, declared enabled states, and their Git CDN imports are complete.
cases.expectedBehavior: Reconcile detected and declared card capabilities, block a missing schema or promised regional script and any enabled-state mismatch, and report embedded assets, Tavern Helper setup, remote imports, and development-only exclusions separately.

cases.prompt: Package card version 2.4.0 with its attached and standalone companion worldbook, making sure an older 2.3.0 worldbook cannot be selected.
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve both artifacts from the active manifest by stable ID, require a machine-checkable version surface, compare attached and standalone worldbooks with maintained source, and reject the stale version.

cases.prompt: What is the exact event name and callback signature for this Tavern Helper MVU hook?
cases.expectedBehavior: Verify an identified source/version and distinguish confirmed facts from inference.

cases.prompt: The status bar works offline but is blank after importing the card into SillyTavern. Diagnose it.
cases.expectedBehavior: Reproduce in a real runtime and trace DOM, console, iframe, permissions, data, and render evidence.

cases.prompt: Review and improve this rolecard control center for mobile, accessibility, and safe state handling.
cases.expectedBehavior: Review the embedded UI contract without introducing a React stack by default.

cases.prompt: Clean up and optimize this ugly but stable module.
cases.expectedBehavior: Audit and gate first; do not edit without evidence and implementation authorization.

cases.prompt: Build an accessible settings dashboard with React, shadcn/ui, Radix, and Tailwind.
cases.expectedBehavior: Use the requested stack, detect the project setup, and guard all generated writes.

cases.prompt: The rolecard workshop publish request now returns 502. Diagnose the chain before changing production.
cases.expectedBehavior: Trace the configurable public/gateway/storage chain read-only and require authorization before deploy or secret changes.

cases.prompt: Only update this character-local status-bar regex. Give me an importable test JSON and do not rebuild or package the rolecard.
cases.expectedBehavior: Freeze component mode, preserve the stable ID and untouched fields, emit only an importable regex artifact plus validation evidence, and produce no card JSON or PNG.

cases.prompt: Update these two Tavern Helper scripts and then package the complete card, but keep every unrelated component unchanged.
cases.expectedBehavior: Freeze full-card mode, build validated script artifacts and an assembly handoff with an untouched-surface hash, then route composition and packaging to sillytavern-card-pipeline.

cases.prompt: Prove whether this card regex runs for AI display at depth 0, is skipped for prompts, and stops after depth 4 using repeatable fixtures.
cases.expectedBehavior: Validate the regex dialect and flags, use the supplied numeric placement without guessing, run display/prompt/depth fixtures, and emit an ordered stage trace.

cases.prompt: The offline replacement passes but the imported regex does nothing in SillyTavern. Work out what the fixture does and what still needs live evidence.
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep the deterministic fixture result, list unsupported host stages, treat the installed runtime as authoritative, and hand exact runtime reproduction to sillytavern-runtime-debug.

cases.prompt: Before I import this card, scan its HTML, helper scripts, regex replacements, and remote loaders for security risks without running anything.
cases.expectedBehavior: Perform a read-only redacted scan, report rule IDs and locations without executing content or exposing credential values, and separate suspicious patterns from confirmed reachability.

cases.prompt: Compare this candidate's rolecard security report with the approved baseline and block any newly introduced rule count.
cases.expectedBehavior: Compare counts by stable rule ID, report positive deltas as regressions, and avoid treating a baseline as a suppression list.

cases.prompt: Migrate my quest table from status to state, add progress=0, preserve custom fields, and prove the migration is idempotent.
cases.expectedBehavior: Validate the multi-floor model, run a deterministic rename plus add-field fixture, preserve unknown data, compare expected output, and prove the second run is unchanged.

cases.prompt: Check that every status-bar and control-center binding names an existing table field and refreshes after message edits and swipes.
cases.expectedBehavior: Validate stable binding IDs, table and field references, access owner and refresh events, keep UI implementation separate, and retain real multi-floor lifecycle acceptance.

cases.prompt: Create a minimal SillyTavern UI extension with a manifest, activation hook, namespaced settings, and a capability contract, but do not install it.
cases.expectedBehavior: Freeze the UI-extension boundary, plan before writing, generate only the minimal scaffold, validate manifest paths and hook exports, and perform no host installation or reload.

cases.expectedBehavior: Validate the inert capability snapshot, block missing required symbols or minimum versions, activate declared optional fallbacks, and keep signatures and live behavior unclaimed.

cases.prompt: Compare this assembled rolecard with the approved build and show exactly which size, prompt, worldbook, regex, script, or media budgets regressed without printing its contents.
cases.expectedBehavior: Measure both artifacts with the same redacted metric surface, apply hard limits and declared growth deltas, identify owners, and avoid deleting behavior merely because it is large.

cases.prompt: Validate the first-render and swipe p95 timings I captured from a named SillyTavern browser/device setup, separately from the card size report.
cases.expectedBehavior: Require a named environment and sufficient captured samples, calculate deterministic percentiles per scenario, and keep static and real-runtime gates independent.

cases.prompt: Audit this card's local and remote media plus Live2D model, motions, expressions, provider, fallback, and teardown bindings without downloading anything.
cases.expectedBehavior: Verify local containment, bytes and hashes, leave remote sources uncontacted, require an explicit Live2D provider and fallback, and pair load/play actions with teardown.

cases.prompt: Plan eager, lazy, and on-demand media under a byte budget and check that BGM playback stops on chat teardown without replacing the user's whole playlist.
cases.expectedBehavior: Produce a non-network preload plan, enforce declared byte and count limits, use only BGM or ambient audio contracts, preserve existing settings, and validate deterministic cleanup.

cases.expectedBehavior: Select the program blueprint profile only from real multi-domain boundaries, create a master index with bounded depth and child limits, extract domain blueprints progressively, freeze runtimePersistentBlueprintBudget at zero for every active step, keep ordinary checklists non-authoritative, and preserve a resumable NEXT handoff.

cases.prompt: 按藍圖執行 P7 時，390px 真機復現了軟鍵盤遮住提交按鈕的問題。允許你臨時細分步驟診斷和修復，但修好後要回到 P7 正常執行，別把這個 Bug 變成新藍圖。
cases.expectedBehavior: Open one evidence-triggered non-persistent problem refinement bound to P7, use only the minimal diagnostic, repair, and recheck actions, preserve the product scope and completion denominator, record resolution evidence, close the refinement, and return to P7 and its original exit condition.

cases.expectedBehavior: Evaluate the frontend host surface against core interaction value, explicitly recommend against an unsuitable independent UI with a lighter fallback and reopen conditions, preserve prototype and real-host gates if the driver overrides, and inspect actual stable legacy artifacts before classifying reuse.

cases.prompt: 照鏡子。請從當前可訪問的 Codex、Chat、專案狀態和交付證據重新核驗完整 Vibe Code 成長曆程，和上一次履歷比較後儲存新節點。
cases.expectedBehavior: Reassess the complete current capability network without treating prior scores as anchors, including deep thinking across social issues, future outlook, observed feedback, project structure, planning, and technical discussion; upstream architecture through original design or demonstrated understanding and application; and innovation through project transformation, wheel reuse, optimization, upgrades, and reference-material use. Separate exact measurements, user reports, estimates, behavioral scores, and unverifiable claims, keep Codex and Chat token scopes separate, map changed rubric dimensions before numeric deltas, return a standalone detailed text assessment plus the seven-part report, preserve the original compact Vibe Code capability-cockpit visual language instead of a TavernWeave tutorial shell, make the core, every capability cluster, and every dimension a full-hit-area native button, validate the existing immutable chain, and append redacted hashed record, report, and assessment files without overwriting history.

cases.prompt: 照鏡子，只要一份可以直接複製儲存的完整文字評估表單，不要畫板。
cases.expectedBehavior: Produce one standalone detailed Markdown assessment from the same structured evidence model, including evidence boundaries, the complete capability network with deep thinking, upstream architecture, and innovation, four core dimensions, token economics, six project gates, history comparability, actions, and final judgment; do not require or substitute an interactive report.

cases.prompt: 洗稿這段：在當前階段，工具可以匯出 3 種格式，但目前暫時還不支援離線同步。總而言之，這項功能具有重要意義。
cases.expectedBehavior: Return one light revision directly, preserving 3 formats and the lack of offline sync; do not activate continuous mode or demand a file-write intake.

cases.expectedBehavior: Distinguish sentence polish, reordered structure, and rebuilt expression; retain all facts, negation, constraints and uncertainty instead of inventing vivid details.

cases.expectedBehavior: Follow the existing genre and character voices; do not impose one colloquial voice, universal banned words, or new actions and motives.

cases.expectedBehavior: Identify the prose field, preserve protected literals and every other structural field, parse the output and compare untouched values and protected spans.

cases.prompt: 開啟持續洗稿模式；後續作品、計劃和審查說明都自然一點。之後我說退出洗稿模式，再給一份計劃。
cases.expectedBehavior: Track task inherit/on/off explicitly; cover daily explanations lightly, stop continuous refinement on the later direct exit, preserve persistent files and permit subsequent one-shot requests.

cases.prompt: 在本工作區開啟洗稿模式。
cases.expectedBehavior: Resolve the effective Codex or Claude workspace instruction target, show scope/path/owned block diff, and wait for approval of that exact preview before the self-contained manager writes.

cases.prompt: 為當前客戶端全域性開啟洗稿模式，然後檢視洗稿模式狀態。
cases.expectedBehavior: Preview the actual client target separately from workspace rules, require concrete consent, and distinguish task state, both persistent scopes and unverified host loading.

cases.prompt: 關閉工作區洗稿模式，客戶端規則保留。
cases.expectedBehavior: Preview and remove only the workspace owned block; retain unrelated bytes and client policy, then report whether another scope still applies.

cases.prompt: 全量審查這個軟體專案，包含實現、配置、測試、介面、遷移和鎖檔案；先只給報告。
cases.expectedBehavior: Use full-scan/general, inventory the agreed snapshot, review files by their actual roles, record exclusions and incomplete coverage, and remain read-only.

cases.expectedBehavior: Use architecture-hotspot-scan/architecture, trace ownership, dependencies, data flow, contracts and lifecycle with source evidence; do not claim full coverage.

cases.expectedBehavior: Review creative authority, relationships, worldbook organization, prompt responsibilities and source/artifact links only where present; absence of optional MVU/frontend is not a defect.

cases.expectedBehavior: Use full-scan/architecture, review software and card contracts together, trace canonical state through projections, and retain coverage and staged recommendations.

cases.expectedBehavior: Keep legacy findings and CLI formats, merge exact coverage duplicates, retain reasons/evidence/conflicts, show legacy coverage as unrecorded, and infer no complete inventory.

cases.expectedBehavior: Activate the disclosed Soul persona and route full-scan/architecture to code-quality-workflow; at most three opening summary points must not truncate any complete findings or severity.

cases.prompt: 不用開啟人格或洗稿，解釋這個普通網頁專案接下來要做什麼、我怎麼判斷做好了。
cases.expectedBehavior: Explain user impact, choices, evidence and next steps in plain language without mode activation, automatic tier assignment or an intake exam.

cases.prompt: 我已選擇入門檔，會匯入卡了，想增加一項成長規則。
cases.expectedBehavior: Explain a small phase in detail, including reasons, relationships, tradeoffs and checks; importing success does not change the tier.

cases.prompt: 我已選擇熟練檔，給現有角色檔案增加一個大圖檢視入口。
cases.expectedBehavior: Group routine operations while explaining the implementation idea, ownership, effects and important decisions; retain lifecycle and validation requirements.

cases.expectedBehavior: Use concise plain-language results, changes and evidence; retain failures, unresolved decisions and the unverified host state.

cases.prompt: 分別按新人、入門、熟練、老手四檔解釋：搜尋一直報返回格式不完整，現有證據只有報錯文字，幫我查原因。
cases.expectedBehavior: Every tier explains observed versus expected behavior, knowns versus hypotheses, investigation, possible repair effects and validation; do not invent a root cause.

cases.prompt: 長期老手檔。這一個故障的原因我知道，後續只給結果不用解釋。隨後我又請求排查另一個不同的 bug。
cases.expectedBehavior: Honor the explicit waiver only in its stated scope, retain failures and unknowns, and resume necessary detailed explanations for the next bug without changing the tier.

cases.prompt: 以後用入門檔。已確認展示的客戶端目標檔案和偏好區塊，現在按這份預覽儲存。
cases.expectedBehavior: Use the independent client preference manager with the authorized current preview, preserve neighboring rules, and report saved files separately from host loading.

cases.expectedBehavior: Enter takeover, inspect the actual package, explain original behavior and missing maintenance sources, retain creative decisions, isolate the first change and check old-chat compatibility.

cases.prompt: 我選入門檔，第一次用，想做個有一個按鈕的小網頁。試用後按鈕能點了，我想再換一下位置。
cases.expectedBehavior: Keep the wish focused on an ordinary webpage, explain each phase, provide a runnable trial, use the trial feedback for a second scoped change and check the new result.

cases.prompt: 隔離環境中已有入門檔和自寫規則，升級並重復安裝 TW，再核對擋位。
cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve the independently owned preference and unrelated rules through upgrade and repeated installation, and keep host loading unverified.

cases.expectedBehavior: Use editable Markdown with derived JSONL and optional SQLite; inspect representative samples before a corpus-bound plan.

cases.expectedBehavior: Preserve canon/fanon, continuity, edition and evidence certainty; keep conflicting versions explicit.

cases.expectedBehavior: Open actual source pages via available host tools and register bounded excerpts with provenance; record unavailable access.

cases.expectedBehavior: Actually inspect images before visual conclusions; register reference metadata and preserve selected-material download scope.

cases.prompt: 從作品資料庫整理開局的人物別名、關係和場景，給我二創資料包。
cases.expectedBehavior: Query current documents by identity, continuity and knowledge stage; retain citations and distinguish new creative additions.

cases.expectedBehavior: Read current Markdown/hash, rebuild observed edit log, resume the same batch and reject stale writes; export without a model call.

cases.prompt: 採用前端沙盒，單獨檢查這個有三層 iframe 的狀態列，保留變數橋和真實原始碼。
cases.expectedBehavior: Verify source and mount topology, declare simulated coverage, prepare isolated fixtures for explicit confirmation, and retain real-host acceptance.

cases.prompt: 做多前端聯合模擬，狀態對照和滑條除錯，一起看 HUD、手機和控制中心。
cases.expectedBehavior: Load actual modules with shared state/events, expose missing interfaces, compare each mapped view, isolate UI parameters and export source-bound results.

cases.expectedBehavior: Reuse skip decision, create no sandbox, and preserve existing development and runtime checks without marking failure.

cases.expectedBehavior: Keep implementation evidence separate, retain acceptance gaps for confirmed blocking bugs including deferred fixes, require retest state, resolution and existing evidence files for closure, and do not promote a feedback record to driver acceptance.

cases.prompt: 把專案進度畫板和已有總設計案、NEXT同步：設計案定義範圍，NEXT更新後展示進度和下一道門。
cases.expectedBehavior: Opt into exact design scope and NEXT state blocks using the actual project paths, derive the board from those sources, review a plan bound to board/feedback revisions and source/evidence hashes before application, preserve history, and keep real-host and driver gates separate.

cases.expectedBehavior: Route to worldbook-design-and-writing, separate entry reachability from condition evaluation, keep missing distinct from false, distinguish native two-branch rule delivery from strict selected-branch output, and retain target-version and real-request verification boundaries.
